qa: Plan, run and record quality checks.
qa activity list: List recent QA runs for a project, item or release.
qa artifact: Store and read evidence files from QA runs.
qa artifact add: Attach an evidence file to a QA run.
qa artifact get: Show the details of one QA evidence file.
qa artifact presign: Get an upload link for a QA evidence file.
qa artifact read: Download a QA evidence file to this machine.
qa artifact rehome: Move QA evidence files into the current store.
qa browser: Control the local browser used for QA.
qa browser context: Read what a browser QA case needs to run.
qa browser context get: Show the address and branch a browser QA case uses.
qa browser screenshot: Take one screenshot of a web page.
qa browser setup: Start the local QA browser for a project.
qa browser status: Show whether the local QA browser is running.
qa browser step: Run one browser action, such as a click or check.
qa browser stop: Stop the local QA browser for a project.
qa browser-context: Read what a browser QA case needs to run.
qa browser-context get: Show the address and branch a browser QA case uses.
qa case run: Run one QA case and record its result.
qa gate: Check which QA cases still block an item.
qa gate summary: List the blocking QA cases still missing evidence.
qa gate-summary: List the blocking QA cases still missing evidence.
qa item plan: Attach or remove a QA plan on an item.
qa item plan attach: Attach a QA plan to an item at one stage.
qa item plan retract: Remove a QA plan attached to an item by mistake.
qa item-plan: Attach or remove a QA plan on an item.
qa item-plan attach: Attach a QA plan to an item at one stage.
qa item-plan retract: Remove a QA plan attached to an item by mistake.
qa method: Read the ways QA cases can be checked.
qa method list: List the QA methods a project can use.
qa methods: Read the ways QA cases can be checked.
qa methods list: List the QA methods a project can use.
qa mission: Run steps of an exploratory QA walk.
qa mission connected-machine: Record the Yoke Machine a walk's connect registered.
qa mission host-command: Run one command on the QA host during a walk.
qa no: Record that a project has no test suite.
qa no tests: Record that a project has no test suite.
qa no tests attest: Record why a project has no test suite.
qa no tests clear: Remove the record that a project has no tests.
qa no-tests: Record that a project has no test suite.
qa no-tests attest: Record why a project has no test suite.
qa no-tests clear: Remove the record that a project has no tests.
qa plan: Create, change and run QA plans.
qa plan abort: Stop a running QA plan, with a reason.
qa plan adopt: Take over a QA plan run left by an ended session.
qa plan cases: Set the cases in a QA plan.
qa plan cases replace: Replace all cases in a QA plan from a file.
qa plan cases sync: Update a QA plan's cases from an exported source.
qa plan create: Create a new QA plan for a project.
qa plan edit: Edit a whole QA plan in your text editor.
qa plan get: Show one QA plan and its cases.
qa plan materialize: Create QA cases from a plan for an item or release.
qa plan reconcile: Settle a QA plan run whose owner stopped reporting.
qa plan rematerialize: Rebuild QA cases from the current plan.
qa plan retire: Retire a QA plan, with a reason.
qa plan review-begin: Get a finished QA run's captures for review.
qa plan review-submit: Submit the review of a QA plan run.
qa plan run: Run a QA plan for an item, release or project.
qa plan-cases: Set the cases in a QA plan.
qa plan-cases replace: Replace all cases in a QA plan from a file.
qa plan-cases sync: Update a QA plan's cases from an exported source.
qa post: Record post-deploy QA decisions for items.
qa post deploy: Record post-deploy QA decisions for items.
qa post deploy declare: Decline post-deploy checks for an item.
qa post deploy declare none: Decline post-deploy checks for an item, with a reason.
qa post deploy record: Record that an item needs no post-deploy check.
qa post deploy record no: Record that an item needs no post-deploy check.
qa post deploy record no obligation: Record why an item needs no post-deploy check.
qa post-deploy: Record post-deploy QA decisions for items.
qa post-deploy declare-none: Decline post-deploy checks for an item, with a reason.
qa post-deploy record-no-obligation: Record why an item needs no post-deploy check.
qa project: Set a project's QA defaults and methods.
qa project default: Choose the QA plans a project uses by default.
qa project default set: Make a QA plan a project default at one stage.
qa project default unset: Remove a QA plan from a project's defaults.
qa project method: Add QA methods for a project.
qa project method register: Register a new QA method for a project.
qa project-default: Choose the QA plans a project uses by default.
qa project-default set: Make a QA plan a project default at one stage.
qa project-default unset: Remove a QA plan from a project's defaults.
qa project-method: Add QA methods for a project.
qa project-method register: Register a new QA method for a project.
qa registered: Set the commands that run a project's tests.
qa registered command: Set the commands that run a project's tests.
qa registered command set: Set the command that runs one test scope.
qa registered-command: Set the commands that run a project's tests.
qa registered-command set: Set the command that runs one test scope.
qa requirement: Add, read and change the QA cases on items.
qa requirement add: Add a QA case to an item or release.
qa requirement add batch: Add several QA cases to one item at once.
qa requirement add-batch: Add several QA cases to one item at once.
qa requirement list: List QA cases for an item, epic or release.
qa requirement rebind: Keep a QA case's evidence for a changed target.
qa requirement rebind target: Keep a QA case's evidence for a changed target.
qa requirement rebind-target: Keep a QA case's evidence for a changed target.
qa requirement supersede: Replace a QA case with a corrected one that passed.
qa requirement transfer: Move a QA case to another item.
qa requirement update: Change one field of a QA case.
qa requirement waive: Waive a QA case, with a reason.
qa review: Create, change and run QA plans.
qa run: Record and read the results of QA runs.
qa run add: Start or record a run of a QA case.
qa run complete: Record the result of a started QA run.
qa run get: Show one QA run and its evidence.
qa run list: List the runs of a QA case.
qa run record: Record a finished QA run's verdict.
qa run record verdict: Record a finished QA run with its verdict.
qa run record-verdict: Record a finished QA run with its verdict.
